requirement_text: A maximum of 10 Free Users shall be allowed in Webble with limited access to features.
user_story: As a Webble product owner, I want the number of Free Users capped at 10 with reduced feature access, so that paying users keep the full feature set.
technical_task: Enforce a cap of 10 Free Users on Webble and give those accounts only a limited set of features.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 Free Users already exist, when another Free User tries to register, then the registration is refused.
Given a Free User, when the user opens a feature outside the limited set, then access to it is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: Webble product owner. The list of limited features is not given.

requirement_text: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210©.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a message digest created for data using the standard cited in § 170.210©, so that tampering can be detected.
technical_task: Add a hashing step that outputs a message digest built as defined by the cited standard, § 170.210©.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be protected, when the hashing step runs, then a message digest is produced.
Given the message digest, when its algorithm is checked, then it follows the standard cited in § 170.210©.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The cited standard is not reproduced in the requirement; the © sign is read as a closing parenthesis of the citation.

requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation)  to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want Clinical Decision Support to show who authored data and who is responsible for it, so that I can trust the information.
technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) by presenting the author and the responsible party for each data item.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data item shown by Clinical Decision Support, when a clinician views it, then its authorship is displayed.
Given the same data item, when a clinician views it, then the party responsible for it is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The details of function IN.1.8 are not in the requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
user_story: As a radio astronomy operator, I want correlator operations to run in real time and hardware to be monitored, controlled and updated remotely over the network, so that I can run the instrument without being on site.
technical_task: Offer network access for real-time correlator operations, monitoring and control of hardware, and PLD/FPGA personality updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a network connection, when the operator starts a correlator operation, then it runs in real time.
Given a network connection, when the operator sends a PLD/FPGA personality update, then the update is applied to the hardware.
rationale: Role assumed: radio astronomy operator. The latency of "real time" is not given.

requirement_text: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
requirement_text_raw: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.'
user_story: As an insurance manager, I want recycled parts audit reports available only to adjusters, so that other staff cannot see them.
technical_task: Limit the request of recycled parts audit reports to users holding the adjuster role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user asks for a recycled parts audit report, then the report is provided.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user asks for a recycled parts audit report, then the request is denied.

requirement_text: Click 'Add' to schedule an office visit.
user_story: As a receptionist, I want an Add button that starts scheduling an office visit, so that I can book a patient in.
technical_task: Place an 'Add' button on the screen that opens the scheduling of an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen with the 'Add' button, when the user clicks it, then the office visit scheduling starts.
Given the scheduling has started, when the user completes it, then an office visit is scheduled.

requirement_text: On cards that are aware of logical channels, the MANAGE CHANNEL commands are only processed by the OPEN and are not dispatched to an Application.
user_story: As a card developer, I want MANAGE CHANNEL commands handled by the OPEN itself on cards that use logical channels, so that applications never see them.
technical_task: On logical channel capable cards, let the OPEN process MANAGE CHANNEL commands itself and keep them away from any Application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card that supports logical channels, when a MANAGE CHANNEL command arrives, then the OPEN processes it.
Given a MANAGE CHANNEL command, when it has been processed, then it was not dispatched to an Application.

requirement_text: System shall restrict users from viewing other users' details to ensure privacy and security.
user_story: As a user, I want other users to be unable to open my personal details, so that my privacy is kept.
technical_task: Deny a user access to the detail pages of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user viewing their own details, when the page is opened, then the details are shown.
Given a user trying to open another user's details, when the page is requested, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Exceptions for administrators are not mentioned.

requirement_text: Sensitive data will be encrypted before being sent over insecure connections like the internet.
user_story: As a customer, I want sensitive data encrypted before it travels over open networks such as the internet, so that nobody can read it on the way.
technical_task: Apply encryption to sensitive data before transmitting it on insecure connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is transmitted, then it is encrypted first.
Given an insecure connection, when sensitive data is sent through it, then only the encrypted form is transmitted.

requirement_text: Enter the appropriate information and click 'Save Form' to return to the Encounter summary page.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to fill in the form and click Save Form, so that I am returned to the Encounter summary page.
technical_task: Accept the form entries and, on 'Save Form', store them and show the Encounter summary page.
acceptance_criteria: Given the form with appropriate information entered, when the user clicks 'Save Form', then the information is saved.
Given the information has been saved, when the click is processed, then the Encounter summary page is displayed.

requirement_text: After the journey, users shall receive a feedback form to provide feedback based on their journey experience.
user_story: As a traveller, I want a feedback form once my journey ends, so that I can tell the operator how it went.
technical_task: Present a feedback form to the user at the end of a journey asking about the journey experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journey has ended, when the user returns to the app, then a feedback form is offered.
Given the feedback form, when the user submits it, then the feedback on the journey is stored.

requirement_text: Record disclosures made for treatment payment and health care operations.
requirement_text_raw: Record disclosures made for treatment  payment  and health care operations.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want disclosures for treatment, payment and health care operations recorded, so that I can account for them.
technical_task: Keep a log entry for each disclosure made for treatment, payment or health care operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a disclosure for treatment, when it is made, then it is recorded.
Given a disclosure for payment or health care operations, when it is made, then it is recorded.

requirement_text: The iTrust user (admin) has been authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
rationale: The sentence describes a state that already holds and gives no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a precondition of a use case or a requirement on the system?
What must the iTrust Medical Records system do once the admin is authenticated?

requirement_text: Please refer the `` Diagnostic Specification Central Display Telematic5 '' [DSPC-4585] for details.
rationale: Only a pointer to another document, with no content of its own.
clarification_questions: Which CAN failures and which display behaviour does the referenced specification cover?
Should the content of the reference be copied into this requirement?

requirement_text: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" .
requirement_text_raw: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" [RD3651].
rationale: A bare reference to a system specification, with no requirement stated.
clarification_questions: What detail about the wireless subsystem is expected from the cited system specification?
Which parts of that document are binding for this requirement?

requirement_text: Each syndrome shall represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
requirement_text_raw: Each syndrome shall (3.2.2.6.4) represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each syndrome to flag that its error happened at some point between two packet deliveries, so that I can narrow down when the error occurred.
technical_task: Set a syndrome so that it marks an occurrence of the indicated error within the interval from the previous packet delivery to the current one.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs after the previous packet delivery and before the current one, when the syndrome is read, then it flags the error.
Given no error occurs in that interval, when the syndrome is read, then it does not flag the error.

requirement_text: Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
requirement_text_raw: 3. Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
user_story: As a phone user, I want a received SMS or e-mail sender saved as a contact, so that I can reach them later.
technical_task: Offer an action that saves the sender details of an incoming SMS or e-mail into the address book application.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incoming SMS, when the user saves the sender, then a contact is created in the address book application.
Given an incoming e-mail, when the user saves the sender, then a contact is created in the address book application.

requirement_text: All three edge points shall be equal to the reference point if the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
user_story: As a perception engineer, I want a very small object described by three coinciding edge points, so that its outline is not more detailed than the accuracy allows.
technical_task: Collapse the three edge points onto the reference point for objects smaller than the required x- and y-accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction, when its outline is built, then the three edge points coincide with the reference point.
Given an object at least as large as the required accuracy, when its outline is built, then the edge points are not collapsed.
rationale: Role assumed: perception engineer. The required accuracy value is not given.
